## WebTrace change proposal

### Change type
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Detection / threat indicator
- [ ] Parser improvement
- [ ] IR playbook improvement
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Performance / usability

### What is changing?
Describe the proposed change clearly.

### Why is this useful?
Explain the analyst or investigation problem this addresses.

### Testing performed
Describe the logs, sample data, or manual testing used.

### Detection / parser considerations
If this changes detection logic or parsing, describe expected matches and possible false positives.

### Documentation
- [ ] README updated if required
- [ ] Relevant docs updated
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] Sample data added/updated if useful

### Review request
This pull request is a **proposal**. It will not be included in the main WebTrace release unless the project maintainer reviews and accepts it.
